maddeler.e:
نتعانق (form VI)
# نَتَعَانَقُ (nataʕānaqu) /na.ta.ʕaː.na.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَانَقَ (taʕānaqa)
# نَتَعَانَقَ (nataʕānaqa) /na.ta.ʕaː.na.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَانَقَ (taʕānaqa)
# نَتَعَانَقْ (nataʕānaq) /na.ta.ʕaː.naq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَانَقَ (taʕānaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
